title: Creamy Italian Pasta Bake
description: A classic Italian-inspired pasta dish with a creamy golden sauce, topped with nutty breadcrumbs. Perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, sauté the onion over medium heat until softened.
Stir in the Italian golden sauce and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, sauce mixture, and nutritional yeast. Mix well.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with nutty breadcrumbs.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the breadcrumbs are golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
